findings.summary: is_near_duplicate returns True for dissimilar vectors and False for near-duplicates due to inverted comparison operator.
findings.mechanism: Spec requires reporting whether cosine similarity meets or exceeds the threshold (similarity >= threshold means near-duplicate). The code uses `<= threshold` instead of `>= threshold`, so it returns True for low-similarity (dissimilar) pairs and False for identical/near-identical embeddings — the exact opposite of intended behavior. The test suite as diffed (identical embeddings expects True, orthogonal expects False) would actually fail against this implementation since identical embeddings give cosine=1.0 which is not <= 0.95.
